$description: Near AI OS Design System, theme dark-hc. Generated by scripts/build.py from tokens/near-ai.tokens.json. Do not edit.

scene.$description: The ground behind a window or page: the desktop stand-in on web and the first-run backdrop. Never under text.

scene-warm.$description: The lighter center of the scene gradient (radial, scene-warm to scene).

scene-glow-1.$description: Web scene glow, top left (radial). Decorative; never under text without a pane.

scene-glow-2.$description: Web scene glow, bottom right. Decorative.

scene-glow-brand.$description: The one brand glow drawn straight on the scene: the welcome glow rising behind a composer, the first-run corner glow. Near AI blue at low alpha; never under body text without a card.

scene-card.$description: A card drawn straight on the scene with no pane under it: the first-run stage's settings card, a welcome screen's card.

scene-control.$description: A neutral control drawn straight on the scene (first-run Back). Lighter than `control`, whose dark well vanishes on the navy scene.

scene-rule.$description: A rule or dashed line drawn straight on the scene, stronger than `rule`.

glass-veil.$description: The tint painted over a pane's native material (or over backdrop blur on web) so text holds 4.5:1 over any desktop. Navigation layer only.

pane-fill.$description: The flat fill painted over the veil on every pane.

pane-base.$description: A pane where no native material or blur exists (modal backing, Android and Windows panes).

pane-opaque.$description: A pane under Reduce Transparency, forced colors or low-power mode: solid. Also the chart and the reference ground for status marks.

card.$description: A card on a pane (painted, never blurred).

card-quiet.$description: A quiet card: inspector sections, menus inside panels, notices.

card-hover.$description: Replaces the card fill under the pointer on an interactive card.

card-on-opaque.$description: A card on an opaque ground (pane-base, pane-opaque): phone and tablet screens, Reduce Transparency, opaque content panes. In dark the glass card matches the opaque pane and would vanish.

card-quiet-on-opaque.$description: A quiet card on an opaque ground.

card-nested.$description: A card drawn on a card: the inner container that holds a detail or an estimate inside a card. One step from the card it sits on; never a third level.

control.$description: The neutral (glass) button, picker and toolbar-group fill.

control-hover.$description: Replaces the control fill under the pointer.

control-on-menu.$description: A neutral control or pill drawn on a menu, popover or other floating surface, where `control` would vanish into the floating fill.

control-on-selection.$description: A neutral control or pill drawn on a selected row (`selection`). Its label and glyph take `text-on-accent`.

well.$description: A recessed track: segmented-control track, legend cell, unchecked checkbox.

field.$description: A text field, text area or select well.

consent.$description: The consent block and code block ground.

popover.$description: A popover, node card or tooltip on the floating layer (over its own blur). 94%: opaque enough that rows and pills under it never show through (owner, 2026-10-05 web and 2026-10-19 macOS).

menu.$description: A menu or dropdown on the floating layer (over its own blur). 94%, for the same reason as `popover`.

scrim-modal.$description: Behind a modal, over an 8px blur of the window content.

inactive-dim.$description: Painted over a pane when its window is not key, so background windows read darker.

hairline.$description: One device pixel between rows inside a list or table. Never around a container.

rule.$description: Under a modal header, over its footer, under tab rows, and section rules.

edge-hc.$description: The 1pt solid edge every painted surface gets under increased contrast.

row-hover.$description: Replaces an unselected row's fill under the pointer. Never over a selected row.

toggle-off.$description: The 16 to 18% ink behind things that are off or empty: a progress track, the spinner ring, the subtle badge. The switch track uses `toggle-track-off`.

toggle-track-off.$description: A switch track when off. In the dark themes it is 38% white so the navy off knob (`toggle-knob-off`) holds 3:1 on it (owner, 2026-10-22).

toggle-knob-off.$description: A switch knob when off. White in the light themes; in the dark themes the same navy as the on knob (`text-on-accent`), so on and off differ by track and position, not by knob.

toolbar-glyph-off.$description: A toolbar glyph whose pane is hidden (3:1 on the control).

toolbar-expanded.$description: A toolbar button whose menu is open.

text-primary.$description: Titles, body and values on every pane, card, field, popover and menu.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting lines, labels, inactive tabs. Same grounds as text-primary.

text-tertiary.$description: Captions, eyebrows, axis labels, timestamps. Same grounds as text-primary.

text-placeholder.$description: A field's prompt. Text, so it holds 4.5:1 on field.

text-placeholder-on-opaque.$description: Placeholder text on an opaque ground (`pane-opaque`, `card-on-opaque`, phone and web shells with no glass). Quieter than `text-placeholder`, which is already at the 4.5:1 floor over the worst glass ground. Never on glass.

accent.$description: The one action and every selected state: primary button, selected segment and row, switch on, checkbox on, radio on. Holds 3:1 against every ground.

accent-pressed.$description: The accent fill while pressed (8% darker, never a fade).

text-on-accent.$description: Labels and glyphs on accent, accent-pressed and menu-hover.

accent-text.$description: Links, accent eyebrows and accent text on every ground text-primary uses.

accent-soft.$description: Accent marks that are not text: series, step-progress nodes, tab ember, promo edges. 3:1 on pane-opaque.

accent-tint.$description: A tinted background behind accent content (accent tags, the selected filter chip ground).

tab-ember.$description: The 2pt line under the selected main tab, fading at both ends.

tab-ember-halo.$description: The glow rising from the tab ember behind the selected title.

focus-ring.$description: The 2px keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control. 3:1 against every ground.

selection.$description: A selected list or table row (with text-on-accent).

positive.$description: Positive status mark (dot, glyph): on, watching, verified. Always beside words.

positive-text.$description: Positive status as text, on every ground and on positive-tint.

positive-tint.$description: Positive tag ground. A notice never takes a tint; its tone is the dot in its title.

proof-text.$description: The word of a passed proof (Verified) and the seal's ink, on `proof-tint`. Calmer than `positive-text` so a proof never reads as a neon success.

proof-tint.$description: The ground of a passed proof: the ProofTag pill, the proof pill in a header, the seal-match box. Opaque, so it reads the same on glass and on paint.

caution.$description: Caution status mark: ask me, pending, needs a look. Always beside words.

caution-tint.$description: Caution tag ground. Never a notice or card fill.

critical.$description: Critical status mark: failed, leaves for an outside model, no proof. Always beside words.

critical-text.$description: Critical status as text, and the inline alert line.

critical-tint.$description: Critical tag ground. Never a notice or card fill.

neutral.$description: Off, never, not used. A mark only: never for text.

destructive-text.$description: The destructive button label and destructive menu items.

badge-fill.$description: The count badge (decisions owed), with text-on-status.

surface-chart.$description: The opaque plot ground of every chart. Series are validated against it; charts never plot straight on glass.

chart-grid.$description: Recessive gridlines and the axis rule.

data-1.$description: Categorical series 1, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-2.$description: Categorical series 2, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-3.$description: Categorical series 3, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-4.$description: Categorical series 4, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-5.$description: Categorical series 5, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-6.$description: Categorical series 6, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-7.$description: Categorical series 7, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

data-8.$description: Categorical series 8, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

ink.$description: Overlay strokes and fills at an alpha: white on dark, black on light.

brand-blue.$description: The "AI" of the Near AI wordmark and the secondary lockup. Logos, illustration and brand moments; in the dark themes it is also data-1 and accent-soft. Not text on a light ground (2.9:1 on pane-opaque).

brand-sky.$description: Near AI Sky, from the near.ai/brand palette. The light steps of brand illustration (the marketing site's dithered art ramp). Logo, illustration and marketing use only; never text or controls.

brand-deep-blue.$description: Near AI Deep Blue, from the near.ai/brand palette. Mid steps of brand illustration. Illustration and marketing use only.

brand-tile.$description: The ground of the Near AI tile (app-icon lockup). Logo use only.

brand-tile-dark.$description: The tile ground of the dark app-icon appearance (macOS and iOS Icon Composer documents). App icons only.

brand-paper.$description: The "N" monogram on the color tile. Logo use only.

brand-ink.$description: The "near" wordmark in the color lockup on light grounds. Logo use only.

gateway-purple.$description: The old Trace purple: Gateway's dark accent until 2026-10-20 (NDS-22). It survives only in the old Trace mark and Gateway's Shared data series (#8a3dff dark, #7a2cf5 light). Never on controls.

space-2.$description: Toolbar-group padding, icon-to-badge nudge, dense field gap (Unity 2px between fields).

space-4.$description: Label above a field, menu-row inset, note line spacing.

space-6.$description: Inline gap: dot to label, icon to label, chip padding.

space-8.$description: Gap between buttons in a bar, menu padding, list-row column gap.

space-10.$description: Gap between panes and between cards (pane-gap, card-gap).

space-12.$description: Pane padding, card padding (vertical), field horizontal padding plus 2.

space-14.$description: Card padding (horizontal), modal body vertical padding, overlay inset on a map.

space-16.$description: Inspector horizontal padding, phone side margin (M3 compact margin), sheet padding.

space-20.$description: Gap above an action bar, first-run step inset, section gap in settings.

space-24.$description: Tablet and web content margin (M3 medium+), large card padding, section gap.

space-32.$description: Web section spacing, gap between pane groups on large screens.

space-40.$description: Empty-state block spacing, hero padding on tablet.

space-64.$description: Hero and marketing section spacing (expressive only).

pane-gap.$description: Between floating panes in a window (and the window edge on web).

inline-gap.$description: Between an icon or dot and its words.

modal-inset.$description: Minimum gap between a modal and the window edge.

modal-inset-top.$description: Gap above a modal (clears the title bar and traffic lights).

dense-padding-left.$description: Dense inspector left padding (Unity Inspector: 18 left, 4 right, 8 top and bottom).

dense-indent.$description: Dense tree and inspector indent per nesting level (Unity, max 6 levels).

tree-indent.$description: Regular tree indent per level, after an 8px inset (trace-commons).

margin-expanded.$description: Page margin from 840px; panes separate with a 24px spacer.

radius-pane.$description: Panes, modals, edge rail, menu-bar panel (flat; classic 16).

radius-control.$description: Fields, large tool tiles, edge-rail tiles (flat; classic 8).

radius-tile.$description: Small tiles, menu items, kebab ground, day-graph chips. The concentric floor.

radius-dense.$description: Dense controls in pro-tool panels (Unity Editor buttons and fields).

radius-window.$description: A window drawn by the app on web and Windows/Linux (the #1146 window radius).

radius-sheet.$description: Bottom sheets and side sheets on touch (top corners only; M3 extra-large).

radius-pill.$description: Buttons, wells, segments, chips, tags, badges, switches: every capsule.

target-pointer.$description: Recommended pointer hit target on macOS and desktop web (minimum 20).

target-touch-apple.$description: Touch hit target on iOS and iPadOS (minimum 28).

target-touch-android.$description: Touch hit target on Android and touch web.

target-spatial.$description: visionOS gaze-and-pinch target (centers at least 60 apart).

size-control-dense.$description: Dense desktop controls and property rows (Unity Editor 18-20).

size-control.$description: Desktop compact controls: round small button, segment, breadcrumb target.

size-control-large.$description: Desktop inline buttons, pickers, text fields, round buttons (inline size).

size-cta-small.$description: Every modal action-bar button (small bar size).

size-cta.$description: Every button in a window or sheet action bar (bar size) and the primary CTA.

size-control-touch.$description: iOS buttons, fields and rows; Android uses 40 visible inside a 48 target.

size-submit-pill.$description: The submit pill on tree rows.

size-list-row.$description: Desktop list row minimum; 44 on iOS, 56 on Android.

size-checkbox.$description: Checkbox and radio on desktop; 22 on touch inside a full-row target.

size-glyph.$description: Default glyph size in a control; 20 on touch toolbars.

size-pane-main.$description: The main (navigation) pane in a three-pane window.

size-pane-inspector.$description: The inspector pane (two thirds of the main pane).

size-rail-expanded.$description: Navigation rail, expanded minimum (max 360); replaces the navigation drawer.

size-sidebar.$description: Desktop and iPad sidebar default width.

size-modal-nav.$description: Section list in a settings modal or window.

size-popover-width.$description: Info popover, node card, tooltip maximum (tooltips max 300 in dense tools).

size-panel-width.$description: Menu-bar panel and edge-rail peek width.

size-readable-width.$description: Maximum line length container for running text (about 65 characters at body).

bp-medium.$description: Compact to medium: phone to small tablet; bottom bar becomes a rail.

bp-inspector.$description: A desktop window shows the inspector pane on first launch.

bp-map.$description: A desktop window shows the content (map) pane on first launch.

bp-large.$description: Expanded to large: expanded rail, three panes.

bp-xlarge.$description: Large to extra-large: wider panes, never wider running text.

opacity-disabled.$description: Every disabled control, whole control. A disabled control shows no hover and explains why nearby.

opacity-row-off.$description: The tool tile of a list row that is off (the title steps to text-secondary instead).

opacity-skeleton.$description: The low point of a skeleton pulse.

opacity-series-reduced.$description: A lighter companion series beside the full-strength one.

duration-fast.$description: Hover and press fills, focus ring, checkbox (fast).

duration-reveal.$description: A compact pill or row expanding in place (reveal).

duration-standard.$description: Modal fade, pane show and hide, menus (standard).

duration-slide.$description: Footers and peeks sliding in, sub-list swaps (slide).

duration-slow.$description: Large-surface fades on web and Android (slow).

duration-pulse.$description: One skeleton pulse cycle (to 0.5 and back).

duration-spring-spatial-fast.$description: Settle time of spring-spatial-fast, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

duration-spring-spatial.$description: Settle time of spring-spatial, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

duration-spring-spatial-slow.$description: Settle time of spring-spatial-slow, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

duration-spring-effects.$description: Settle time of spring-effects, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

duration-spring-expressive.$description: Settle time of spring-expressive, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

duration-spring-ember.$description: Settle time of spring-ember, to pair with its linear() curve on web.

ease-standard.$description: The one curve for fades, fills, hover and press (trace-commons). Every non-spatial change.

apple.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

web.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif

android.$value: "Roboto Flex", Roboto, "Google Sans Flex", system-ui, sans-serif

mono.$value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Roboto Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

micro.$description: Tag and badge words, chart tick labels.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase labels over cards, fields and sections (tracked).

caption.$description: Sub-lines, helper text, timestamps, inline alerts.

label.$description: Control labels: buttons inline, pickers, segments, field text.

body-strong.$description: Emphasised body: row titles, primary button labels, card titles.

heading.$description: Pane and screen headings, inspector headers.

display.$description: One headline per screen: onboarding, empty hero states.

number.$description: Hero figures and balances, tabular digits.

mono.$description: Paths, hashes, sizes, figures that describe what leaves the device.
